# Lint reads @Json's "\u0000" UNSET_NAME default as the JSON name of every @Json without a name
# argument, so two @Json(ignore = true) members are reported as duplicates of "\u0000". Moshi uses
# the member name there, so krit does not report them.
- src/main/java/com/example/Unique.kt:15:57: MoshiUsageDuplicateJsonName: Name '\u0000' is duplicated by member 'c'.
- src/main/java/com/example/Unique.kt:15:94: MoshiUsageDuplicateJsonName: Name '\u0000' is duplicated by member 'b'.
